_comment: Mini-dungeons the catalogue (datos/dungeons.json) does not have: the ones a quest NPC takes you
into. Same fields; the rooms are kept in the order written and the last one is the boss room
(DungeonManager.Dungeon.Authored). Ids above the catalogue's (it ends at 205).
Or a catalogue dungeon Ankama remade after the catalogue's rooms were written, under the
catalogue's own id, which this entry replaces whole. «door»: 1 keeps a guardian at the entrance
who takes the key or the keyring (DungeonHandler), where a mini-dungeon's NPC lets you in by his
own tree. «quarry»: room -> the monsters its fight brings besides the boss, as the quests'
objectives put theirs (DungeonManager.Dungeon.WrittenQuarry). «roster»: room -> who its group is
made of, in the place of its subarea's monsters (DungeonManager.Dungeon.WrittenRoster).
«empty»: the rooms only walked through, with nobody in them; the door at their far side leads
on (DungeonManager.Dungeon.EmptyRooms). «alone»: room -> the monsters fought there, all of them
and nobody else (DungeonManager.Dungeon.AloneRooms). «lingering»: the rooms not to stay in, the
curse that warns whoever comes in and the curses earned by the seconds spent there (LingeringRooms).

60.name: Cavernas de Tejossus
60.why: Kolosso's Caverns as the game has them. Dofus pour les noobs, «Cavernes du Kolosso»: «vous pouvez effectuer les 4 première salle dans l'ordre que vous voulez, il vous faut réunir les 4 reliques», then «parlez au Professeur Xa pour entrer et traversez les 3 salles vides». The first room is the lobby: its four doors (content/interactives/teleports.json) lead to the Icy, Venomous, Bestial and Pyrotechnic rooms, whose floor passages lead back to it, and a win in each lands next to its door. The Blérices' room has the Blérice, Blérom, Wolvero and Croleur; the other three are mostly Bléroms, Blérauves and Fleuros. The win in the last of the four takes the place of the relics and Professor Xa, who has no spawn in the client: it leads into the Second Room, and the Second, Third and Fourth are walked through by their floor passages to the Kolosso in the Fifth. The catalogue walked First -> Second -> Third -> Fourth -> Fifth with a fight in each and never the four element rooms.

3.name: Biblioteca del Maestro Cuerbok
3.why: Lord Crow's library as Ankama remade it on 21 January 2025 (Dofus pour les noobs, «Bibliothèque du Maître Corbac»): one walks its sixteen rooms freely (content/interactives/teleports.json), beats its three unique monsters for their feathers (content/fights/win_alterations.json), and Virgil, in the First Room [-15,-61], «Montrer les plumes, et utiliser le trousseau de clefs», lets the holder of the three in with the key or the keyring: «une salle avec le Capsaalocke et la salle du Maître Corbac». The catalogue's three rooms are kept: the throne room (159125512) is the boss's, where «Voler dans les plumes» (1775) has him beaten (11394), and its antechamber (159124488) is where Natacha waits after it (11395), the room after the boss (content/world/dungeon_exits.json). INFERRED: Capsálocke's room is the remaining one, the Library Annexe (159121666), since no objective names his map (11392). Who each of the two rooms is made of: «chaque monstre a un nom différent s'il accompagne le Capsaloocke ou le Maître Corbac [...] Les monstres qui accompagnent le Maître Corbac sont les mêmes que ceux que vous devez trouver dans la Bibliothèque»; the client's subarea 211 lists both sets together, Capsálocke's being the Bebesangres, the Jefe cuerbok and the Cuerbok adiestrado (4578-4580, of subarea 211 alone) and the Master's the library's three unique monsters (823-825).

6.name: Antro del Dragocerdo
6.why: The den's thirteen rooms in the order their names give (First to Thirteenth Room), its fights in every other one: Dofus pour les noobs, «Antre du Dragon Cochon»: the first two are crossed quickly, «sinon vous obtiendrez une malédiction assez gênante : Gaz Méphitique»; the third brings Cerdos de Farle and Cerdos serranos (603, 3304), the fifth adds the Don dórgano (601), the seventh is the same, the ninth adds the Don dessangre (600); the fourth, sixth, eighth, tenth and twelfth are empty («Rien de spécial dans cette salle continuez jusque la prochaine»); the eleventh is the mini-boss, the Marranórgola (3137) alone -- its side of the map has one starting cell --, and the thirteenth the Dragocerdo. The catalogue put a group in every room, the Marranórgola in the first. The doors of the empty rooms are the 2.73 graph's floor passages, and content/interactives/floor_passages.json for the second and fourth. INFERRED: the boss's companions, the rooms' grades. The first two rooms are not to be lingered in: whoever comes in carries «Efluvios nauseabundos» (13284, «Si respiras mucho tiempo los gases de esta sala, sufrirás las consecuencias»), which goes when he reaches the third; still in them, it turns into «Gas mefistofélico» (13282) and then «Gas mefistofélico potente» (13283), four fights each -- INFERRED times, 60 and 120 seconds. The porco of the entrance (784) keeps the door.

18.name: Picos Rocosos de los Crujidores
18.why: Crackler's Rocky Peaks in the order Dofus pour les noobs walks it («Pitons Rocheux des Craqueleurs»): fights in Salle 1 to 5 (First to Fifth Room), then «traverser un pont invisible» of three lines, walked on the middle one cell by cell or «vous tomberez»; whoever falls finds a monster below and fighting it «remonter» him to try the bridge again; then the boss. The Sixth Room (106959872, the guide's picture of the bridge is titled «Sixième salle») is that bridge, with nobody in it: its stairs on the far plateau (element 480373, cell 251) climb to the Seventh Room, the boss's (669). The bridge's outer lines drop to the Plateau below (106959874: the 2.73 graph's floor passage on cell 359, and content/interactives/floor_passages.json for the others), whose win brings the party back up to the bridge's foot, cell 372 under the middle line («hub»: the Sixth Room is its lobby and its «then»). 106957826 and 106957828 are the walkway under the Fourth Room's wooden bridge: the 2.73 graph's floor passage on its cell 179 leads down, 106957826's ladder (480371) back up; the guide's route never crosses them, and they are kept empty so that the base's generated groups, some with the boss in them, do not stand there. The catalogue chained a fight in the Sixth Room straight to the boss and put the Plateau and the walkway after him. INFERRED: who stands on the Plateau (the guide names no monster: it keeps a group of the dungeon's own), the landing cells, and which bridge cells drop (the two outer lines; the guide only says the middle one holds).

13.name: Mazmorra de los Bworks
13.why: The Bwork Dungeon as Dofus pour les noobs walks it («Donjon des Bworks»): «Après la salle 3», a transition room, «la salle du cachot», with a pit in its floor; «en cliquant sur la porte» one goes on to the next room, and whoever falls into the pit climbs back by «l'échelle pour remonter». The maps name them: 104599041 is «Donjon des Bworks - Cachot» (Solitary Confinement), the transition room, empty; its round door (element 477758, cell 302, content/interactives/teleports.json) leads to the Fourth Room. The grille in its middle drops to 104599043, «Cachot de Kreuvète» (Swimp Confinement), by the 2.73 graph's floor passage on cell 372; its ladder (477755) climbs back to the Cachot. The guide puts a Tamed Trool (791) and Kreuvète the Bwork (2680, levels 200 to 220) in the pit, says «il n'est pas nécessaire de les combattre», and Kreuvète only while the Bwork invasion of the Crackler Mountains is on, which this server never runs (WorldEvents): the pit holds the Trool alone, and a win there lands back at the Cachot like the ladder («hub»). The rooms' monsters are the Bwork, Bwork Mage and Bwork Archer with the Bworkette in the Fifth Room (JeuxOnline's dungeon sheet; the Unity guides count three monsters and the boss): the subarea also lists the Trool and Kreuvète, who stood in every room. The catalogue walked the five rooms straight and put both cells after the boss, where nothing led. INFERRED: the landing cells (312 in the Cachot, where a win in the Third Room lands; 326 in the Fourth Room), and that the pit's Trool fights alone.

9001.name: Laboratorio Secreto
9001.why: Doctor Niet's hidden laboratory under the grassy plains [-55,4] (subarea 473): «Le fils caché» (237) of Dofus pour les noobs, «4 x combats», First to Fourth Room, then the Exit room where his son Juan hides.

9002.name: Claro floribundo
9002.why: The Floribund Clearing (subarea 462, «Clairière de Floribonde» [-53,13]) where Doctor Morros takes you after his wife: «La femme perdue» (238) of Dofus pour les noobs, «téléporté dans un mini-donjon infesté de mobs», «6 x combats», every screenshot of them on «Île d'Otomaï (La clairière de Floribonde) -53,13», then «vous trouvez sa femme» there too; the quest's own text sends you to find her in the Dark Jungle. Its seven maps share [-53,13] and have no border, interactive or graph edge: rooms reached only by being sent. INFERRED order: the six fights by map id, Juana in the last.

4.name: Centro del Laberinto del Minotauroro
4.why: The Minotoror's room behind Lorkos, in the labyrinth's centre (34473220): «Taures et détours» (Dofus pour les noobs) goes in with the key and the two relics and beats the Minotoror (8663), then casts the spell at the antechamber's stone throne (8664). The catalogue counts the antechamber (34473476) as a fight room; it is the room after the boss (content/world/dungeon_exits.json), the Minotot's door, the throne and the Minotot are there. Lorkos takes the relics by his written replies (takesAll), so «required» keeps the key alone: the door spends the first of its items the character holds. Who the room is made of: subarea 210's monsters without the two bosses and its level 1 extra (3740). INFERRED exit: the Entrance (34476296), where the arch leads back to the island; the catalogue's 34476294 is a copy of it with no way out.

53.name: Sala del Minotot
53.why: The Minotot's room behind Lorkos in the antechamber: «tendrás que traerme la llave de su sala» (3211), the key of the Minotot's room (8307) or the keyring. The catalogue also lists the Minotoror's key and relics, and the door spends the first of them the character holds; they open the room before. Its group is the Minotot with the same family as the Minotoror's, not the Minotoror himself. INFERRED exit, as dungeon 4's.

11.name: Enclave de los Blops
11.why: The enclave's four fight rooms (Sala 1 to 4), whose last leads to Bibiblop's hall (dungeon_exits.json), where each Royal Blop's room is chosen (dungeons 9003 to 9006): Dofus pour les noobs, «Clos des Blops»: «Après la quatrième salle, vous pouvez choisir le Boss que vous voulez affronter parmi les 4 Blops Royaux. Une fois le Blop Royal choisi vaincu, vous pouvez décider de combattre le Blop Multicolore ou de quitter le donjon». The catalogue chained its ten rooms by their names, with the hall, the exit room and the four Royal rooms after the fourth, and no Royal Blop in any of them. Its rooms are the subarea's blops without the Royal ones. Bibiblop keeps the door at the entrance (5402).

49.name: Antro del Blop Multicolor Real
49.why: The Royal Rainbow Blop's lair, entered from the enclave's exit room: «Pour rentrer dans ce donjon il faut au préalable être dans la salle de sortie du donjon Clos des Blops... Enfin, parlez à Bibiblop pour entrer» (Dofus pour les noobs, «Antre du Blop Multicolore Royal»), whose 5410 offers it to whoever holds its key (9254) or the keyring; the Royal Rainbow Blop «sera accompagné des 4 Blops Royaux». Its five are all bosses and come whole to whoever comes in, alone or not («le Blop Multicolore qui sera accompagné des 4 Blops Royaux», «Clos des Blops»): drawn from a roster of the four, the group came with two Indigo and two Coco and, alone, without the Reinette. The catalogue gave it the enclave's entrance, where the enclave's own door was always the one opened, and listed the enclave's key with its own, either of which the door spends.

9003.name: Sala del Blop Coco Real
9003.why: The Blop Coco Real's room of the Blop enclave, chosen at Bibiblop in the hall (dungeon 11): Dofus pour les noobs, «Clos des Blops»: «Après la quatrième salle, vous pouvez choisir le Boss que vous voulez affronter parmi les 4 Blops Royaux. Une fois le Blop Royal choisi vaincu, vous pouvez décider de combattre le Blop Multicolore ou de quitter le donjon»; with the classic blops («Les Blops classiques de leur côté...»). Its win leads to the exit room (dungeon_exits.json).

68.name: Sala Privada de Klim
68.why: Klime's private room in the order its maps name it: First, Second and Third Room, the Annex, the Fourth Room and Klime's own. The catalogue's partial names put the Annex after the Fourth Room and gave it a fight. Dofus pour les noobs, «Salons privés de Klime»: «Entre la salle 3 et la salle 4, vous arrivez dans une salle annexe sans monstres. Il sera nécessaire de trouver un passage secret pour pouvoir accéder à la salle 4 : Activez simplement le chandelier le plus proche» (content/interactives/teleports.json).

133.name: Memoria de Orukam
133.why: One fight, in three waves, on The Rock (Dofus pour les noobs, «Mémoire d'Orukam»: «un unique combat de 3 vagues»). The catalogue also lists The Voyage (211550208) as a room after it, so the keeper sent people there first and the boss room was not the last: its fight was a plain one of eight. The room's group is the waves' own monsters: King Imagami, then Imorok, Imafugo and Imetsu, as the first wave is written, and Imiyama and Imushin for more people.

134.name: Recuerdo de Imagiro
134.why: One fight, in three waves (Dofus pour les noobs, «Souvenir d'Imagiro»: a single room, as in every dungeon of the divine dimensions). The catalogue lists a second map (211812352) that is the dimension's travel point, as The Voyage is for the Memoria de Orukam, so the keeper sent people there first and the fight was split in two. The boss room is the one where the quest asks for Queen Amirukam; its group is the waves' own monsters: the Queen, then Fugokam, Rokoram and Tsunam, as the first wave is written, and Mabram and Shinlam for more people.

140.name: Cámara de los Maleficios
140.why: The catalogue's exit is the dungeon's own post-boss room (223875074, «Salida»), so leaving it led back into it and no one got out. The room after the boss is in content/world/dungeon_exits.json; the way out is the entrance map. INFERRED: the outside map, the catalogue naming no other.

141.name: Bastión de los Martilloseco
141.why: The catalogue's exit is the dungeon's own post-boss room (225185794, «Salida»), so leaving it led back into it and no one got out. The room after the boss is in content/world/dungeon_exits.json; the way out is the entrance map. INFERRED: the outside map, the catalogue naming no other.

42.name: Despensa de la Rata Blanca
42.why: The catalogue's exit is the dungeon's own post-boss room (218632194, the White Rat's last room), so «Salir de la mazmorra» led back into it. The room after the boss is in content/world/dungeon_exits.json, where the White Rat lets the winners out; the way out is the entrance map she takes them to.

43.name: Raratonera de la Rata Negra
43.why: The catalogue's exit is the dungeon's own post-boss room (218894338, the Black Rat's last room), so «Salir de la mazmorra» led back into it. The room after the boss is in content/world/dungeon_exits.json, where the Black Rat lets the winners out; the way out is the entrance map she takes them to.

115.name: Guarida de Karnozor
115.why: The catalogue's exit is the dungeon's own post-boss room (199495682, «Kharnotaurus's Lair - Exit»), which has no border, no interactive and no NPC, so the winners were shut in. The room after the boss is in content/world/dungeon_exits.json, where Lee O'Summerly offers «Leave Kharnotaurus's Lair.»; the way out is the entrance map, where he keeps the door. INFERRED: the outside map, the catalogue naming no other.

142.name: Refugio Silvestre
142.why: The catalogue's exit is the dungeon's own post-boss room (224137218), which has no border, no interactive and no NPC who leads out, so the winners were shut in. The room after the boss is in content/world/dungeon_exits.json, where Raccooper offers «Leave the Sylvan Refuge.»; the way out is the entrance map. INFERRED: the outside map, the catalogue naming no other.

58.name: Guarida de los Gélifux
58.why: The Snowfoux Den as the game has it: its four fight rooms (First to Fourth Room), whose last leads to the transition room where Givrihaltès (1385) offers the two boss fights (dungeons 9007 and 9008, dungeon_exits.json). Dofus pour les noobs, «Tanière Givrefoux»: «Une fois que vous avez terminé la salle 4, vous arrivez dans une salle de transition où vous pouvez choisir entre affronter Tengu Givrefoux seul ou Tengu et Fuji Givrefoux ensemble». The catalogue chained eleven rooms, the Path and the Exit to the Petrified Forest first, and the boss fight always brought Tengu, Fuji, Yomi and Kami together. The rooms are the den's Maho, Soryo, Yokai, Yomi and Kami Snowfoux. The guardian keeps the door at the entrance (key 11178 or the keyring). INFERRED: the Throne Room (59516928) as the transition room, the old boss room the two new Snowfoux Den maps replaced.

21.name: Mazmorra de los Herreros
21.why: The Blacksmith Dungeon is branched (Dofus pour les noobs, «Donjon des Forgerons»): the keeper sets you down in the Entrance, an empty room whose door (element 505079, cell 262) opens on the First Room; First and Second Room are fights; the Third Room is an empty crossroads whose two doors are the 2.73 world graph's (cell 221 to the Fourth Room, cell 174 to the Sixth). The short way fights the Fourth and Fifth Room and then the boss in the Last Room. The long way walks the Sixth Room (empty, ore) to the Seventh (fight) and the Eighth (empty, ore), whose doors lead to the Emote Room (cell 178, the stele of the «Saluer» attitude, with a door back on 355) and to the Ninth Room (cell 404, fight), whose win opens on the Last Room. Fights only where the client has a fight board for the room (First, Second, Fourth, Fifth, Seventh, Ninth, Last). The catalogue fields are the catalogue's; the rooms are written in the client's numbers, so the Fifth Room's win is written to open on the Last Room («next»).

9007.name: Tengu Snowfoux's Room
9007.why: Tengu Snowfoux fought on his own, chosen at Givrihaltès in the Snowfoux Den's transition room (dungeon 58): Dofus pour les noobs, «Tanière Givrefoux»: «Une fois que vous avez terminé la salle 4, vous arrivez dans une salle de transition où vous pouvez choisir entre affronter Tengu Givrefoux seul ou Tengu et Fuji Givrefoux ensemble». The Yomi and the Yokai are there from the start (their weapon hit and push lift his invulnerability), and the Kami with them: «Fuji remplace la Kami Givrefoux dans le combat» in the other fight. The larger of the two Snowfoux Den maps: «La map de Tengu et Fuji Givrefoux est beaucoup plus petite que celle du Tengu solo». Its win leads to the Exit to the Petrified Forest (dungeon_exits.json).

9008.name: Tengu and Fuji Snowfoux's Room
9008.why: Tengu and Fuji Snowfoux together, chosen at Givrihaltès in the Snowfoux Den's transition room (dungeon 58): Dofus pour les noobs, «Tanière Givrefoux»: «Une fois que vous avez terminé la salle 4, vous arrivez dans une salle de transition où vous pouvez choisir entre affronter Tengu Givrefoux seul ou Tengu et Fuji Givrefoux ensemble»; «Fuji remplace la Kami Givrefoux dans le combat», on «La map de Tengu et Fuji Givrefoux [...] beaucoup plus petite que celle du Tengu solo», the smaller of the two Snowfoux Den maps. Fuji is 3234, the boss the catalogue lists for the dungeon. Its win leads to the Exit to the Petrified Forest (dungeon_exits.json).

30.name: Cueva del Trankitronko
30.why: Koolich Cavern in the order its corridors walk: the First and Second Room, then Koolich's Lair through the Second Room's right-hand corridor (its First to Sixth Room, where the Boufcouls are), out of its Sixth Room into the Cavern's Third Room, and the Fourth and Fifth, Koolich's own. The catalogue's names gave two First Rooms and the Lair was never reached; the Exit is the post-boss room (dungeon_exits.json), not a fight. Koolich is fought alone, with only the Gobballs he summons (Dofus pour les noobs, «Caverne du Koulosse»): the koalaks of his subarea were standing beside him.

15.name: Guarida del Maxilubo
15.why: Moowolf Lair in the order its rooms are numbered: First to Fourth Room, Fourth Room II, Fifth, and the Moowolf in the Sixth. Two maps share the ordinal four and the Exit has none, so the names gave no order and the catalogue's list stood, starting in the Third Room; the Exit is no fight room and a win over the Moowolf leaves by the entrance.

24.name: La Gelexta Dimensión
24.why: The Jellith Dimension in the order a run takes it: the First to Fourth Room, then the Fifth Room, the hall where the four royals stand (dungeon_exits.json), then the royal room the puddles open (dungeons 9009 to 9013), then the Exit room. The catalogue listed the royal rooms and the exit first, so a royal win ended the run and the Fifth Room held four royals. Dofus pour les noobs, «Gelaxième Dimension»: «Dans chaque salle du donjon, il y a 4 groupes. Chaque groupe est composé de manière différente afin qu'il y ait un type de gelée majoritaire dans chacun des groupes»; «Une fois le combat terminé, vous obtiendrez en inventaire une flaque de gelée de la couleur de la gelée majoritaire»; after the fourth room the royals wait, «parlez à n'importe laquelle d'entre elles pour accéder à la salle du boss»; «Pour affronter les 4 Gelées Royales en même temps, il faudra avoir une flaque de chaque couleur de Gelée». The way in is the Multygely, «il suffit de consommer un Multygely pour être téléporté dans le donjon», and «il n'y a donc pas de sauvegarde dans ce donjon»: no door. 'colours' maps each jelly (Blueberry 55, Mint 56, Strawberry 57, Lemon 429) to its royal's room and 'all' to the Royal Jellies' room (DungeonPuddles). INFERRED: how each group mixes its colours (MobSpawnManager.ColourRoster), that the highest puddle count opens its royal and a tie opens each tied one, and that the Fifth Room is the hall.

9009.name: The Jellith Dimension - Royal Blue Jelly
9009.why: A royal room of the Jellith Dimension (dungeon 24), reached from the Fifth Room's royals when the puddles open it: Dofus pour les noobs, «Gelaxième Dimension»: «parlez à n'importe laquelle d'entre elles pour accéder à la salle du boss». Its fight is the Royal Blueberry Jelly (58) with Blueberry Jellies (55); «Chaque Gelée Royale invoque une Gelée au tour 1». Its win leads to the Exit room (dungeon_exits.json), a defeat back to the dimension's way in. INFERRED: the jellies beside the royal.

9013.name: The Jellith Dimension - Royal Jellies
9013.why: A royal room of the Jellith Dimension (dungeon 24), reached from the Fifth Room's royals when the puddles open it: Dofus pour les noobs, «Gelaxième Dimension»: «parlez à n'importe laquelle d'entre elles pour accéder à la salle du boss»; «Pour affronter les 4 Gelées Royales en même temps, il faudra avoir une flaque de chaque couleur de Gelée». Its fight is the four royals together with jellies of the four colours; «Chaque Gelée Royale invoque une Gelée au tour 1». Its win leads to the Exit room (dungeon_exits.json), a defeat back to the dimension's way in. INFERRED: the jellies beside the royal.
